---
title: "Contributors"
---

State-of-Health BC is built by the people listed below. The list is
generated from the repository's GitHub contributors graph, so it credits
everyone who has contributed commits — code, documentation, data, and
review — to the project.

{{< include _contributors-list.md >}}

GitHub counts a contribution as one commit to the repository; the numbers
above are therefore commit counts, not a measure of how much time or
expertise went into the work. Contributions that arrive through pull
requests opened from a fork are credited to the fork's account.

Want to join them? See [how to contribute](../how-to/contribute.qmd) —
open an issue before starting non-trivial work.
